from collections import Counter, deque

def components(cells):
    cells=set(cells); out=[]
    while cells:
        c=cells.pop(); comp=[c]; q=deque([c])

            r,cc=q.popleft()
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

        vert=(max(rs)-min(rs))>=(max(cs)-min(cs))
        for (r,c) in seeds:
